left_after.why: the empty catch leaves recomputed undefined, which matches no hash, so unreadable terms are refused either way
recomputed is null only after the catch, and null never equals a stored hash, so dropping the null test refuses the same proposals
would let a proposal in the resuming set run in any status; resumeInterrupted (src/policy/saga.ts) only ever adds EXECUTING actions to that set, and beginExecution checks the status again
